ixchel_sample.character.doll: You. The doll looks at the pointer.
ixchel_sample.character.attribute.max_he: Health you have when fully healed, in half hearts.
ixchel_sample.character.attribute.armor: Reduces damage from most attacks; each point is half an armor icon.
ixchel_sample.character.attribute.armor_: Keeps armor effective against strong hits.
ixchel_sample.character.attribute.attack: Damage of a fully charged melee hit with what you hold.
ixchel_sample.character.attribute.luck: Improves loot table rolls, such as fishing.
ixchel_sample.index.title: Ixchel UI samples
ixchel_sample.index.hint: Click a screen to open it, a HUD to show or hide it. Esc closes.
ixchel_sample.index.env.title: Environment HUD
ixchel_sample.index.env.description: A compass bar with the waypoints (J), what the crosshair is on (block with tool and states, or an entity's health), biome, time, weather, light, position; hearts, armor, food, experience.
ixchel_sample.index.character.title: Character panel (G)
ixchel_sample.index.character.descriptio: Your inventory with tabs: a paper doll that looks at the pointer, attributes with tooltips, effects that blink as they end, and statistics from the server.
ixchel_sample.index.machine.title: Machine panel
ixchel_sample.index.machine.description: A powered stonecutter (Functional Blocks tab): fuel makes FE, a water bucket fills the tank, pick a recipe; redstone mode and side configuration. Opening it here places one next to you.
ixchel_sample.index.storage.title: Storage terminal
ixchel_sample.index.storage.description: Every chest and item handler within 8 blocks as one virtual grid: search (@mod filters by mod), sort by name, count or mod; click takes a stack, right-click half, shift-click into the inventory; click with a stack to store it. The terminal item (Tools tab) opens it too.
ixchel_sample.index.loot.title: Loot radar HUD
ixchel_sample.index.loot.description: Brackets over the drops in view, a nearby list with distance and a turning arrow, and pickup toasts that merge, bump their count and run out.
ixchel_sample.index.loot-list.title: Loot radar list (U)
ixchel_sample.index.loot-list.descriptio: Drops nearest first with their direction, a rarity filter, and a pick-up button the server only honors within 8 blocks.
ixchel_sample.index.waypoints.title: Waypoints (J)
ixchel_sample.index.waypoints.descriptio: Session list with keyboard selection, a scrolling list and distances that follow the player; Up, Down and Delete are template key filters.
ixchel_sample.index.config.title: Config panel
ixchel_sample.index.config.description: The sample's client config: categories, search, toggles, sliders, number and text fields, enum selects, colors and a list editor dialog; changes are checked against the spec and saved or discarded. Also behind Mods > Ixchel sample > Config.
ixchel_sample.index.quests.title: Quest tree
ixchel_sample.index.quests.description: 99 quests in three chapters on a canvas you drag and zoom; a quest unlocks when the ones before it are claimed, asks you to hold some items, and the server checks the claim before it gives the reward.
ixchel_sample.index.guide.title: Guidebook
ixchel_sample.index.guide.description: A two-page book: contents built from the entry templates, links with Back, page turns by arrow or key, styled paragraphs with items in the line, Chinese text, and crafting grids that cycle through the accepted ingredients.
ixchel_sample.index.tooltips.title: Element tooltips
ixchel_sample.index.tooltips.description: Rich tooltips on buttons, form controls, terms in text and items (vanilla, custom, custom with the item's own lines); a scrolled list at the screen edge, nesting, a component, a countdown and a dialog.
ixchel_sample.index.effects.title: Visual effects
ixchel_sample.index.effects.description: Group opacity: overlapping boxes, items and text fade as one, beside the same content faded piece by piece, and a card that fades with its item; every filter function, blend mode and backdrop filters behind rounded glass; shader effects: a glint, a tint that follows the pointer, cards that burn away; outlines, letter spacing, new gradients, skew and a ported pen of fighting game health meters.
ixchel_sample.index.themes.title: Themes
ixchel_sample.index.themes.description: The four built-in themes, vanilla, dark, holo and amber, on one showcase of every surface and control in each state; the tabs switch themes and the boxes stay where they are.
ixchel_sample.loot.title: Nearby drops
ixchel_sample.machine.no_recipes: Put a block to cut in the left slot.
ixchel_sample.quests.title: Quests
ixchel_sample.quests.hint: Drag to pan, wheel to zoom, click a quest
ixchel_sample.quests.state.locked: Locked: finish the quests before it
ixchel_sample.storage.sort.name: Name
ixchel_sample.waypoints.title: Waypoints
ixchel_sample.waypoints.hint: Click a row or use Up/Down; Delete removes. Distances update as you move.
ixchel_sample.waypoints.empty: No waypoints yet. Add one where you stand.
ixchel_sample.waypoints.add_title: Saves the block you stand on, in this dimension
ixchel_sample.guide.title: Ixchel Guide
ixchel_sample.guide.intro: %s A sample guidebook. Every entry is a template under ui/guide/entries, so editing one in a development run reloads it in place.
ixchel_sample.guide.navigation: Click a link to follow it; Back or Backspace returns. Turn pages with the arrows or ← →.
ixchel_sample.guide.circuits.heading: Circuits
ixchel_sample.guide.circuits.dust: %s Redstone dust carries a signal up to 15 blocks; each block it crosses weakens it by one.
ixchel_sample.guide.circuits.torch: A %s redstone torch is a power source that turns off when the block it stands on is powered.
ixchel_sample.guide.circuits.piston: A <link>piston</link> pushes up to twelve blocks when powered.
ixchel_sample.guide.circuits.lamp: A %s redstone lamp lights up while powered and goes dark two ticks after the signal ends.
ixchel_sample.guide.circuits.repeater: A %s repeater restores a signal to full strength and delays it by one to four ticks; right-click it to change the delay.
ixchel_sample.guide.circuits.diode: <muted>Signals do not pass through a</muted> <s>repeater</s> <muted>backwards: it is a diode.</muted> Keep the parts of a build in <link>storage</link> nearby.
ixchel_sample.guide.pistons.heading: Pistons
ixchel_sample.guide.pistons.planks: Any %s planks will do for the top row: the grid shows each kind in turn.
ixchel_sample.guide.pistons.power: Power a piston with <link>redstone</link> and it pushes the blocks in front of it; a sticky piston pulls the first one back when the power ends.
ixchel_sample.guide.pistons.immovable: Obsidian, bedrock and blocks holding items cannot be moved.
ixchel_sample.guide.storage.heading: Storage
ixchel_sample.guide.storage.chest: A %s chest holds 27 stacks; two side by side make a double chest of 54.
ixchel_sample.guide.storage.hoppers: Hoppers move items in and out of a chest; a comparator reads how full it is as a <link>redstone signal</link>.
ixchel_sample.tooltips.hint: Hover anything; the tooltip follows the pointer
ixchel_sample.tooltips.name: Name
ixchel_sample.tooltips.name.tip: Shown above your head, at most 16 letters
ixchel_sample.tooltips.mode.tip: How the light level is shown
ixchel_sample.tooltips.terms.text: A %s is the unit of every delay; a %s counts in them.
ixchel_sample.tooltips.terms.repeater.ti: Delays a signal by 1 to 4 redstone ticks
ixchel_sample.tooltips.items: Items: vanilla, custom, custom with the item's lines
ixchel_sample.tooltips.apple.text: Eat it when the hearts run low
ixchel_sample.tooltips.nested: Nested: the deepest wins; title for comparison
ixchel_sample.tooltips.outer.title: The outer box (title)
ixchel_sample.tooltips.inner.tip: The inner box, over the outer one
ixchel_sample.tooltips.inner.title: The inner box (title)
ixchel_sample.tooltips.list: A scrolled list at the screen edge
ixchel_sample.tooltips.entry.tip: Not clipped by the list; flips at the screen edge
ixchel_sample.tooltips.badge.text: The badge puts what it is given into its tooltip
ixchel_sample.tooltips.native.tip: The mod draws this element; @UiElement declares its tag on the painter class
ixchel_sample.config.title: Ixchel sample settings
ixchel_sample.config.restart_note: Some changes apply after rejoining a world
ixchel_sample.config.reorder: Drag onto another line to move it there
ixchel_sample.config.status.invalid: Fix the values marked red to save
ixchel_sample.configuration.indexTitle.t: Title shown above the sample index (H), at most 48 characters.
ixchel_sample.configuration.theme.toolti: Color theme of the sample screens and HUDs.
ixchel_sample.configuration.showEnvHud.t: Show the environment HUD in the top-left corner.
ixchel_sample.configuration.hudScale.too: Scale of the environment HUD relative to the GUI scale.
Accent color of HUD bars and highlights, as 0xRRGGBB.
Show the waypoint compass under the environment HUD.
ixchel_sample.configuration.compassRange: Distance in blocks within which waypoints appear on the compass.
Color of waypoint markers on the compass, as 0xRRGGBB.
ixchel_sample.configuration.maxWaypoints: Maximum number of waypoints kept per world; read when joining a world.
ixchel_sample.configuration.pickupToasts: Show a toast for every item picked up from a loot drop.
ixchel_sample.configuration.toastSeconds: How long a pickup toast stays on screen, in seconds.
ixchel_sample.configuration.blockedItems: Item ids never offered in loot drops, e.g. minecraft:rotten_flesh.
Screen corner the pickup toasts stack in.
ixchel_sample.effects.hint: Each pair: the effect on the whole group, then piece by piece
ixchel_sample.effects.clip_paths: clip-path: inset() round, circle(), ellipse(), polygon(), then a polygon morphing
ixchel_sample.effects.mask_images: mask-image: a linear fade over a list, a radial spot, an item texture
ixchel_sample.effects.corner_shapes: corner-shape: round, bevel, notch, scoop, square, then a shadow
ixchel_sample.effects.fonts: font-family, text-transform and font-size: default, minecraft:uniform, minecraft:alt, uppercase, a § kept as text, 6px at its crisp size; bundled Orbitron and Share Tech Mono through @font-face, Chinese falling back to the default font
ixchel_sample.effects.css_pen: Ported pen RockStarwind/pozBLqd: click a meter

ixchel_sample.index.boss.description: For the nearest mob tagged ixchel_boss: a wide bar with a damage trail, phase marks and the shield over it, the title glitching into each phase, and the boss's effects with their time sweeping out.
